timing_comparison.cache_each: Fresh isolated symbolic cache; OS filesystem/library page caches uncontrolled.

limitations: Original has a separate50-term ExtraXOrder setting; native has no directly equivalent option. Accuracy agreement is independently checked at35relative digits against40-digit original outputs.

Native symbolic-epsilon preparation is required at this sample: the first sampled-preparation attempt rejected ambiguous dimensional indicial sectors and is retained separately. Successful process timing excludes that failed0.204s attempt.

Preparation is included on both sides; native phase split contains full automatic recursive boundaries, reductions and transport, with no manually supplied peel value. Native top basis has3spanning integrals; original has2.
No additional native higherprecision timing run was added because the independent original comparison passed; existing finite/Laurent refinements remain separate evidence.
One process on each ofCPU32/33 was used on a shared host. OS page-cache state and other CPUs were uncontrolled; this is a bounded case observation rather than a controlled repeated benchmark.

Process timing includes executable/kernel initialization and output; original SolveIntegrals timing excludes package startup. The native process linked an alreadycompiled production library, as the original used alreadyinstalledWolfram/Kira/Fermat.
Both outputs are checked without importing original values as native boundary data.
The public Laurent accuracy claim remains20digits; the finite sample is independently checked35digits and no inference beyond the original40-digit precision is made.

resource_scope_correction.kind: Retrospective clarification; original launch records and numerical/timing measurements are unchanged.
resource_scope_correction.original_launch_limit: The launcher set a16GiB per-process hard RLIMIT_AS inherited by Wolfram,Kira and Fermat. It did not establish a16GiB aggregate limit over all descendants.
resource_scope_correction.original_rss_monitor: The original runner polled only the Wolfram kernel process group. Kira can create its own group, so the reported peak_process_group_rss_bytes may exclude Kira/Fermat and is not aggregate workflow RSS.
resource_scope_correction.original_timeout_cleanup: The original runner signaled the kernel process group only. This completed finite run exited0 normally; it did not have the later ancestry-aware watcher.
resource_scope_correction.no_retroactive_watcher: An ancestry watcher was added only to the subsequent all-four paper run. No earlier run is claimed to have used it.
resource_scope_correction.comparison_limit: Reported RSS quantities are not a matched memory benchmark.
resource_scope_correction.native_rss_scope: Native timing used one in-process RustRed/ODE executable; its polled RSS covers that process, not a generic descendant-tree policy.
